background: Group of 6 friends in Canggu, want a fun casual night, watching spend
budget: Low — looking for cheapest viable option
questions_asked: What's the cheapest you can do for 6 people?
Another company quoted us less, why are you more?
winning_replies: Converted per-person price into a group total with inclusions, then closed for the date

conversation.text: 6 of us in Canggu Saturday. What's the cheapest you can do?

For 6, our BBQ is the best value — IDR 450,000++ per person with chef, staff, and equipment all included, so no surprise add-ons. That's about IDR 3.27M all-in for the whole group. Want me to hold Saturday?
Another company quoted us less though.

Some quotes look lower because chef, staff, and gear get added later. Ours is all-in at IDR 3.27M — fixed. For a Canggu Saturday I'd hold the date now with a small deposit so you don't lose the slot. Shall I?
Brilliant. I'll send the deposit link and a short dietary form now. Any allergies in the group?

notes: Good outcome: value framing + group total + immediate close beat a cheaper competitor.
